description: Validate GTIN-8, UPC/GTIN-12, EAN/GTIN-13 and GTIN-14 check digits; no product lookup. PAID: 300 micro-dollar service credits per successful call. First use agent_utilities_prepare for this tool. Requires existing credits and a private Authorization header. Reuse prepared arguments for recovery; a new requestId is a new billable operation.

maxPriceMicroUsd.description: Explicit maximum new debit; 0 means recovery only.

requestId.description: Persist the ID returned by agent_utilities_prepare. Reuse after uncertainty.

name: commerce_gtin_validate
